module purpose: neorv32_pwm decodes bus requests (address bits 5..2, strobe, read/write) into per-channel write and read strobes for NUM_CHANNELS neorv32_pwm_channel instances (lines 94-112); each channel stores an enable, prescaler select, polarity, clock divider and duty value written from the bus data (lines 183-188), counts selected clock-generator ticks and duty steps (lines 211-228), and registers a PWM output level (lines 231-235). The top entity OR-combines channel readback onto bus_rsp_o.data (lines 70, 81-88), ORs the channel enables onto clkgen_en_o (line 121) and drives the channel outputs on pwm_o (lines 116-117).

use-case flows.value: per-channel write and read eligibility of a bus access, decided from the address match, strobe and read/write bit and delivered to the channel
channel configuration (enable, prescaler select, polarity, clock divider, duty) taken from the bus write data and held per channel
clock-divider count advanced on the selected clock-generator tick and the tick event raised when it reaches the divider setting
duty counter advanced on each divider tick
PWM output level decided from enable, duty counter, duty setting and polarity, registered, and driven out of the top entity
clock-generator enable request: each channel's enable exported and OR-combined at the top
stored channel configuration returned on a qualified read, OR-combined across channels and placed on the bus response
configuration, counters, tick, PWM output and bus response cleared while rstn_i is low

conceptual assets.concept: Channel enable setting -- whether a PWM channel runs or is held idle
conceptual assets.reasoning: Configure flow: `cfg_en <= wdata_i(31);` under `if (we_i = '1')` (lines 183-184). The operate flows depend on it: `if (cfg_en = '0') then cnt_cdiv <= (others => '0');` (lines 212-213), the duty counter clear (lines 224-225) and the forced idle level in `if (cfg_en = '0') or ...` (line 231). Integrity is Established: a wrong enable stops or starts counting and forces or releases the output against the written setting. Availability is Established for holding the value between writes (lines 183-184) and its continuous export by `clkgen_en_o <= cfg_en;` (line 197). Confidentiality is not established: readback at line 194 has no restriction beyond re_i. cfg_en stores (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 3, line 184); wdata_i sets it (SOURCES cfg_en, occurrence 2, line 184), read by its entity to store; channel clkgen_en_o is an exit port (COPIES cfg_en, occurrence 2, line 197); rdata_o is an exit port of the readback (DERIVES_FROM cfg_en, occurrence 2, line 194). Channel elements exist per generate iteration (lines 94-112) only when NUM_CHANNELS (line 24) is at least 1; the map carries no configuration record for this.

conceptual assets.concept: Clock-divider count -- the channel's progress within one divided period
conceptual assets.reasoning: Operate flow: `cnt_cdiv <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(cnt_cdiv) + 1);` (line 219) on the selected tick (line 214), cleared when it equals cfg_cdiv (lines 215-216) or when cfg_en = '0' (lines 212-213). The flow graph lists cnt_cdiv as self-updating state. Integrity is Established: the count decides when cnt_tick fires (`if (cnt_cdiv = cfg_cdiv)`, line 215; CONSTRAINS cnt_tick at occurrence 4). Availability is Established under the implemented conditions: with cfg_en = '1', reset inactive and the selected clkgen_i bit high at a rising edge, the count advances or wraps. cnt_cdiv stores (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 6, line 219). clkgen_i only enables this counter's step (GATES cnt_cdiv and cnt_tick, line 214), so it is a clock-enable input and is not reported.

conceptual assets.concept: Divider tick event -- the decision that one divided period has elapsed
conceptual assets.reasoning: Operate flow: `cnt_tick <= '0';` by default (line 211) and `cnt_tick <= '1';` (line 217) when the channel is enabled, the selected clkgen_i bit is high (line 214) and cnt_cdiv = cfg_cdiv (line 215). The duty counter advances only on it: `elsif (cnt_tick = '1') then cnt_duty <= ...` (lines 226-227; GATES cnt_duty at occurrence 5). Integrity is Established: a spurious or missing tick changes the duty counter's rate and so the PWM period. cnt_tick is a register whose value is this decision; by role precedence it stores (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 4, line 217); the same occurrence carries CONSTRAINED_BY cfg_cdiv and SELECTED_BY cfg_prsc.

conceptual assets.concept: Duty counter -- the channel's position within the PWM period
conceptual assets.reasoning: Operate flow: `cnt_duty <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(cnt_duty) + 1);` (line 227) on each tick (line 226), cleared while cfg_en = '0' (lines 224-225); the flow graph lists it as self-updating state. Integrity is Established: the output decision compares it with the duty setting, `(unsigned(cnt_duty) >= unsigned(cfg_duty))` (line 231; CONSTRAINS pwm_o at occurrence 6). Availability is Established under the implemented conditions: with cfg_en = '1' and reset inactive, it advances on every tick. cnt_duty stores (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 4, line 227).

conceptual assets.concept: PWM output level -- the per-channel output decision driven out of the module
conceptual assets.reasoning: Operate flow: `if (cfg_en = '0') or (unsigned(cnt_duty) >= unsigned(cfg_duty)) then pwm_o <= cfg_pol; else pwm_o <= not cfg_pol;` (lines 231-234), registered on clk_i and cleared to '0' on reset (line 207). The top entity wires each channel output into pwm(i) (line 105) and drives `pwm_o(pwm'range) <= pwm(pwm'range);` (line 117), with unused bits held at zero (line 116). The consumer of pwm_o is outside the supplied RTL, so Integrity is Established under the integrator assumption: the consumer must receive exactly the level defined at lines 231-234. Availability is Established for the registered output on each rising edge while reset is inactive. Channel pwm_o is an exit port ahead of its storage role (CONSTRAINED_BY cnt_duty, occurrence 3, line 232); top pwm_o is an exit port (DERIVES_FROM pwm, occurrence 3, line 117). pwm (top) only carries the sub-unit output to pwm_o (CONNECTS from pwm_o at occurrence 2, SOURCES pwm_o at occurrence 5) and is not reported. The MAP CHECK lists 'pwm SOURCES pwm_o' without a partner, but top pwm_o holds DERIVES_FROM pwm at occurrence 3 and line 117 confirms the assignment.

conceptual assets.concept: Clock-generator enable request -- whether any channel needs the external clock-generator ticks
conceptual assets.reasoning: Report flow: each channel exports `clkgen_en_o <= cfg_en;` (line 197), the top wires it into ce(i) (line 104) and drives `clkgen_en_o <= or_reduce_f(ce);` (line 121). The request leaves the module to a clock generator that is not supplied, so Integrity is Established under the integrator assumption: the consumer must receive exactly the OR of the channel enables defined at line 121. No liveness of the external generator is assumed. Top clkgen_en_o is an exit port (DERIVES_FROM ce, occurrence 2, line 121); channel clkgen_en_o is an exit port (COPIES cfg_en, occurrence 2, line 197). ce only carries the sub-unit outputs to the reduction (CONNECTS from clkgen_en_o at occurrence 2, SOURCES at occurrence 3) and is not reported. The MAP CHECK lists 'ce SOURCES clkgen_en_o' without a partner, but top clkgen_en_o holds DERIVES_FROM ce at occurrence 2, and line 121 confirms it.

conceptual assets.concept: Channel configuration write permission -- whether a bus write is allowed to update a given channel's configuration
conceptual assets.reasoning: Start and configure flows: `sel(i) <= '1' when (bus_req_i.addr(5 downto 2) = ...)` (line 109) and `we(i) <= sel(i) and bus_req_i.stb and (bus_req_i.rw);` (line 110) decide the write per channel; we(i) is wired to we_i (line 99), and `if (we_i = '1') then` (line 183) is the only condition under which the configuration registers take bus data (lines 184-188). Integrity is Established: a wrong decision writes the wrong channel or drops a write, breaking the configure flow. we computes the decision (GATED_BY sel, occurrence 3, line 110); we_i sets it in the channel (GATES cfg_en, occurrence 2, line 183), read by its entity to decide on every configuration write. Not reported: sel also qualifies reads (GATES re, occurrence 4, line 111), so it is an operand of the decision, not the decision; bus_req_i is a record carrying complete transactions (addr, data, ben, stb, rw), so it is transport and excluded whole and by field.
